cases.summary: Through the binary's connect bridge, one framed connection carries pipelined, fragmented requests of every effect class; each reply is correlated by id, a launched terminal is live, a document holding future_status and u64::MAX round-trips byte-exactly, and the schema the client package exports is the one the server discovers.

cases.summary: An operation id outside the retention window is the typed op_expired refusal carrying its op_id, answered once and never committed; a literal non-UUIDv7 op id is invalid_params at params.op_id; a numeric u64 is invalid_params; the connection keeps serving after every refusal.
